issues.explanation: An empty signature segment decodes to an empty string, and hash_equals() throws on empty inputs instead of returning false, so a crafted token yields 500 rather than the required 401 invalid_token.
The old proposal status lines were kept alongside the new implemented status, leaving the contract doc self-contradictory.
The IP fallback never triggers because sha1('') is truthy, so unauthenticated requests share one bucket instead of falling back per IP as intended.

review.summary: The change implements the full totem BFF contract with correct pairing, JWT, scope intersection, issuance via IssueTicket, throttling, CORS and docs. A malformed token with an empty signature crashes in hash_equals instead of returning 401, plus a stale proposal status line remains in the docs, so it needs small fixes before merging.
